findings.title: control_alpha_abs_ratio_lt display row reports the reciprocal of the frozen rule's ratio
findings.detail: family_verdicts.json control gate row shows observed 0.8304 = |anchor alpha|/|control alpha| (0.01271891/0.01531670), the reciprocal of rule (g)'s quantity |control|/|anchor| = 1.2042.
